Message:
net: remove SK_MEM_QUANTUM and SK_MEM_QUANTUM_SHIFT

Due to memcg interface, SK_MEM_QUANTUM is effectively PAGE_SIZE.

This might change in the future, but it seems better to avoid the
confusion.
